texto: We are destinies that crossed paths while walking their ways.
Life places us before paths that our mind turns into labyrinths.
If sometimes we do not fulfill our dreams, it is because we are afraid to live them.
The hard part is not choosing between many paths. The hard part is choosing a new path when the ones we took did not lead us to the destinations we dreamed of.
In the game of life, time rolls the dice, and we are the pieces, but we do not know the goals.
The world is round so that wherever we are, we always arrive at the place where our dreams will come true.
Never forget that we will one day return to the place we came from, and what matters is what we live from the moment we leave until we stop.
It is normal that sometimes we feel lost, because days are new destinations that we discover as we live.
So many times I have lost my train, that I have learned to walk.
To live is to pretend you know where you are going, but without really knowing where you will head.
Those who never felt fear to undertake new paths are the ones who got to know new destinations.
We are paths that sometimes cross, and other times, separate.
Life is a changing path, and knowing this is important, because we are the ones holding the steering wheel.
If the moon, when there are clouds, struggles to find the way to shine again, learn its lesson, because if you give up, you will never know what it is to win.
The future is always a possibility, but the present is a reality.
To make a journey, the most important thing is not the luggage, but the company you choose to enjoy the scenery.
Your destination will always be that place where they know how to value you.
It is up to us to turn our failures into dramas, or into the most valuable lessons of our lives.
You are your path. You are your own destination.
If your destination is Friday, you might as well start walking the path on Friday.
We insist on worrying about where we are going, when life has proven that we will end up where we never imagined.
The worst paths are not the ones we mistakenly travel, but those we will never get to see out of fear.
The future we are waiting for in the present we are living makes us miss out on what we are experiencing.
Without knowing it, we are inventing the paths we will walk every time we dream of the day we will meet.
People are rivers following the course of our lives, to end up flowing into the end of our days.
If every time we feel we are falling, we give up, we will never know how our destinations would have turned out.
Always remember that every step we take is the footprint we leave behind.
If death is the destination, life is the path.
All paths have stones we trip over. Cowards are frightened by the cry of their laments, and the brave get up and keep going to reach their dreams.
Life does not depend on days, weeks, months, or years, because our lives can always change in a matter of seconds.
Even if the present is hard, always trust in your future.
If past times seem better to you, it is a good time to reflect on whether you are living what you want.
We have two options: fight to change what we do not like, or lament what displeases us.
We are all the result of our thoughts and our feelings, which sometimes we control and other times are the paths in which we get lost.
We may not have been able to choose the life we have, but we can choose the attitude with which we live.
Living consists of deciding which path to choose.
Sometimes the path seems so complicated that we might think of giving it up, but we will always keep walking, because if we give up, we will never know what was waiting for us.
The destination of our lives is not to know or to have. The destination of our lives is to learn to love.
Even if you walk the path you choose, destiny will decide where you end up.
I may never become your destination, but I dream of accompanying you along the way.
Even if we do not know where we are going, we will reach our destination, even if it is not the one we imagined.
If we fight against our destiny, we can change it, but if we accept it, we are left only to suffer it.
We can limit ourselves to reading our destinies or strive to write what we want.
We should never fear the difficulties we will find along the way, because only if we have courage will we reach our destination.
We may not always have what we deserve, but we can always fight to achieve the dreams we hold.
We will not become heroes by being victors, but by being tireless fighters.
Only those who fight can triumph, and whoever gives up is left with the doubt of not knowing what could have happened to them.
Our mind looks for excuses to prevent us from doing what we do not want, but it always finds a reason to do what we desire.
Many times we will feel like prisoners, but we forget that with our decisions we have become our own jailers.
Some of the applause we dedicate to many celebrities should be destined for all anonymous heroes.
If we have to be something, let us be destiny. If we have to be nothing, let us be silence and each follow our own path.
If you do not share the path with me, never dream of being my destiny.
We started walking together because we fell in love, and we keep walking the path together because we ended up loving one another.
We are the present we write when we live and the past we read when we remember.
The end of a path is the beginning of the journey to a new destination.
Nobody understands that life is the path we walk, not the destination we dream of.
Nothing is written even if sometimes we forget it, for life waits for us to write together.
We all know the destination we want to reach, but we will never arrive if we waste time making plans to travel.
The present you are now living is the future you were waiting for.
It does not matter where we were. It matters where we will be.
Your destiny is not written. You write it as you walk the path.
Life is a journey that will be better or worse depending on the destinations we go to and the company we choose to travel the paths.
The time we spend waiting can never be recovered.
We have one day to die, but all the days of our lives are meant for living.
We cannot guess the future to avoid mistakes, but we can avoid them in the present by making good decisions.
Think of what you will take with you when you die, to know if the life you lead is worth it.
The future you were expecting is the present you are in.
It is not luck, but our decisions that make us live successes or suffer disappointments.
We should never forget that we only need an instant to be born and at any moment we can vanish.
We waste time thinking about where we will be, because we can remember where we were and check where we are.
Do not forget that tomorrow can be a better day, but it will never be worse.
Coincidences hardly exist, but what is harder is for opportunities to repeat themselves.
Losers are losers because they tried to seize opportunities, and winners are winners because they knew how to profit from coincidences.
Destiny tells you that there will always be a smile to share, a dream to live for, and a whole life to write.
We all have dreams, but we must not forget that one day we will wake up.
We value time so little that we waste it, and in the future we will regret it when we want to have the time we squandered.
We will be happier the day we understand that we will take nothing of what we have, and that we will always keep everything we live.
If today you are where yesterday you were not without imagining it, remember that it is absurd to worry by thinking about where you will be tomorrow.
From what I lived, I learned. From what I will live, I will discover.
Never regret what you have lived. Because from everything you have lived, you have learned.
Never forget that life will not wait for you, so go out and live because otherwise it will go on without you.
Even if sad endings exist, with them life opens the door to new and better opportunities.
It is absurd to live remembering our dead if we do not dedicate attention or time to them when they were alive.
With nothing we are born. With nothing we leave, only what we live is what we take with us.
Time is a fortune that we are all going to save, and that we spend when we start to remember.
We tend to think too much so as not to get anywhere.
We should not wait to be happy when we reach happiness, because that is not our destination. Happiness is the attitude with which we must walk the path.
We can doubt whether we know where we are. We can doubt where we will arrive. But we must never doubt who we are and the value we possess.
Others can make our days good or bad, but only it depends on us for our days to be perfect.
Everyone searches for happiness, but few remember that sometimes it is found in tranquility.
Living is not so complicated. You just have to ignore whoever ignored you and learn from the mistakes of the past.
We were not born to dream up what we will be. We were born to live as we are.
We can all be happy. We just have to value what we have and keep our illusions alive.
We can constantly search for happiness, but it is easier to be happy by enjoying every single instant.
Value what you have, fight for what you want, and never regret your decisions.
Enjoy all the good moments now, because the day will come when you will only be able to live your memories.
Our life has only one purpose, and that is that we always live our days with happiness.
We have dreams when we sleep, but we only reach them awake when we chase them.
If we are incapable of being better, at least we should strive not to end up being worse.
We may be similar, but each of us is unique and unrepeatable.
The gifts we give do not depend on the wrapping being better, but on the feelings we have when we look for them.
You illuminate my days and guide the destiny of my steps when you look at me.
In my past lives I searched for you, but in this one, I will find you.
The footprints we leave in life are the marks left by our dreams when we chase them.
If tomorrow does not exist and the past does not repeat itself, enjoy your present as much as you can.
In space we are just a point. In time we are just a brief moment.
Even though you will walk the path you choose, it will be destiny that determines where you arrive.
The fool searches for destiny while the wise person knows that what is truly important is the path.
Nobody knows, nobody understands, that life is the path, not the destination.
No one has ever been seen reaching anywhere without having traveled first.
Never go out just to search. If you go out, do it to find.
If when we are tired we go to sleep, when we are awake we should go out and live.
If when you slept everything was possible, when you wake up nothing will be impossible.
You shine in the sky of my skies. You illuminate the horizon of my lips. You are the light that my desires await every night.
They will forget you for the shadow you left, or they will remember you for the light you cast when you gave love.
Do not allow anyone to turn off the light of your smiles, because those of us who love you every day need them.
If I have something to pass on to you, let it be the joy you feel by my side constantly.
Smiles can be the dress with which we clothe our joys, or the disguise with which we hide our tears.
People shine when we turn on our smiles and disappear when we dim with our sadness.
We may have reasons to cry and show our sorrows, but we do not need excuses to live our best smiles.
Real happiness will not be provided by the riches you have, but by the smiles you give away.
When you feel you are drowning in a sea of tears, remember that we all learned to swim thanks to our smiles.
Never rejoice in the misfortunes of others, because life blindly deals out sorrows and tomorrow you may be the one to suffer them.
Being happy does not depend on the luck you have. You will be happy when you decide to be.
Our happiness does not depend on the actions of others. It only depends on what we decide.
Although every day we are the same, you change, depending on your desire to live and whether you choose to dress in tears or smiles.
Never forget that the sun needs no company to shine in freedom and, moreover, generously shares its light and warmth with everyone.
On occasions we let tears be in excess and smiles be lacking in our lives.
Life gifts us days to live, and we are the ones who must put illusions and smiles into them.
Happiness is being grateful for what we have without lamenting what we want, even if we think we will never have it.
If the storm is inevitable, your smile is the best raincoat.
The key lies not in what we do, but in the enthusiasm we put into everything we do.
You put on the smiles, and destiny gifts you life so you can share your joys with everyone.
The best sun is not the one that casts a shadow on others, but the one that astounds by the light it gives to others.
Never trust the praise of strangers, because the words of your friends will always be more sincere.
I prefer to be the smile that erases your tears, rather than the presence that disappears when you need it most.
Everyone can write our tears, but only we are the authors of our smiles.
Life looks more beautiful when your smile shines.
Life has value when days are lived with love.
Do not cry for what you lost. Always smile for what you lived.
I could spend life dreaming, but I have decided to spend it flying.
Love needs no definition because whoever feels it in their heart never needs words.
My eyes left tears in oblivion, and ever since I am the sea where my smiles shine.
Our home will always be wherever they know how to love us.
Nothing nor anyone will be able to defeat you because a woman never falters.
Whoever makes you smile is the one who teaches you the best way to live.
Never forget that it is the smiles we give and the tears that are stolen from us that make us great.
If you expect nothing from life, you will feel that you find something good every day.
Never forget that wishing good morning with smiles will make the people you live with happy.
When our tears speak, words are unnecessary for our feelings.
When our thoughts cover themselves in black, all colors disappear from our feelings.
When there is disorder in our feelings, we will find no order in our thoughts.
No one deserves our bitterest tears, because we should all enjoy our sweetest smiles.
Our moods do not change our lives, but they can turn them into tears or smiles.
If your tears are ice, smiles are the best combination to drink away your sorrows.
We all have superpowers when we are polite and kind to others.
We tend to want to have it all thinking we will be happy that way, when we are incapable of living cheerfully with what we already have.
We worry about appearing happy, but we change nothing to stop being unhappy.
Our happiness does not come hand in hand with others. Our happiness depends on us.
Run away from people who are jealous, and also from those who are avaricious.
Whoever dresses in lies feels naked.
There will always be someone who wants everything you have, but your worth will never be taken from you.
Never let your thoughts be turned off. Let your feelings always illuminate you.
A life without hope is like a book without words.
Do not forget that even in the darkest nights, the stars never stop shining.
Never forget that the sun illuminates us all, because it does not care who we are, where we are, or where we were born.
When you see clouds in the sky, remember that they are not eternal, so trust that the sun will shine again when it feels drawn by your smiles.
Your smiles have more value than you think, because you give meaning to the lives of those to whom you dedicate them.
If we do not lack money to live, perhaps we should find reasons to smile.
Never forget that the very same person who gifts you smiles today may have shed many tears before.
There are those who leave the cold of their shadow wherever they pass, and there are those who, wherever they pass, astound.
Our mood does not change our lives, but it depends on whether we dim with our tears or shine with our smiles.
You are wrong if you believe farewells are wounds, because they are the opportunity for us to discover that there are more stars in the sky.
We may feel tired at times, but that means we are trying to reach our dreams.
Success is the destination of all those who did not give up while they were traveling the path.
We must accept that we lost on the day we gave up.
Only dreamers know that what seemed impossible, once achieved, is incredible.
It is normal for us to make mistakes because it is the price one must pay to see our dreams and illusions fulfilled.
Merit is not having and wanting more, but dreaming, fighting, and in the end, proving your worth to others.
Do not waste your life fighting with everyone. Fight for your dreams to come true.
The worst mistakes we can make are to lament what we did not say, to repent for what we did not do, and not to learn from the mistakes we made.
They will remember you for your successes, never for what you did not do because you let yourself be defeated by your fears.
The worst thing about believing we know everything is that it makes it impossible for us to learn.
You may have problems for which you cannot find solutions, but they are still great opportunities to prove that you never give up.
The stars will not approach us no matter how much we look at them, nor will we be closer to reaching our dreams if we do not move.
Luck is never going to come looking for you, so if you wait for your luck to change without doing anything, you might as well stay seated and waiting.
Life does not help those who give up. Life usually smiles at those who, despite everything, keep going.
Reaching any dream may seem impossible, but if you do not give up, you will make it possible.
We can never erase the bad moments from our lives, but we can always fight to make our dreams a reality.
If we were to remove the days we spent lamenting from our lives, value if it makes sense to waste time dedicating it to laments.
Do not fear failure when trying to reach your dreams, because the doubts you will swim in, thinking about what would have happened if you hadn't let yourself be dragged by your fears, are worse.
I prefer to know what happened by trying than to dedicate the future to thinking about what it would have been like to live it had I achieved it.
Do not wait for others to recognize your merits, because only you know that your dreams have no limits.
We want to be the best already, and we forget that to become masters, one must first be an apprentice.
If you give up, say goodbye to the dreams you have.
It does not matter if we are winners or losers, because what will always make us different is that we are great dreamers.
There is no dream so crazy that it cannot be reached, nor fear so great that it cannot be overcome.
Whatever you decide, whatever you live, never give up.
Miracles exist because they are the dreams of those who never give up.
To make your dreams come true, you only need to work to live them.
Winners are those who, instead of thinking they were losers, thought about how to turn their dreams into realities.
We get frustrated if we do not reach our dreams, and we forget to enjoy what we live while awake.
You may feel that everyone failed you, but the important thing is that you do not fail yourself, and never stop chasing your dreams.
We become our own worst enemies when we give up.
The only winner is the one who works to overcome their limits, not in defeating their competitors.
We are all apprentices when we fall, and we become masters when we get up.
It is never too early to start dreaming, nor too late to start over.
The first step to learning how to fly is to start dreaming.
The worst thing that can happen to us is not having dreams. The worst thing is that we forget to chase what our desires dictate.
Fighting for your dreams can be tiring, but if you give up, you will live knowing that nothing is going to change.
We are not everything we dream we will be, because sometimes we settle for what we already are, and other times we become overconfident believing we will achieve everything.
They may force us to live awake, but they can never steal our dreams.
Those who fight with all their strength prove their worth, but those who do not give up despite not having any strength have even more worth.
If you think life is not giving you opportunities, that is not true, and taking advantage of them depends on what you decide in every moment.
As long as you have a dream to fulfill, you have a reason to live.
Our success does not depend on the height of the mountain, but on the willpower that our soul demonstrates in the climb.
We must always remember that we were born free and nothing stops us from chasing our dreams, because we must not turn the fears we feel into barriers.
Our success does not depend on the possibilities we have, but on taking advantage of the opportunities we find.
Success is not having won, but having tried, and despite feeling that we did not reach our goals, having continued.
I prefer to have a list of lived wishes than a list of projects that were only dreams.
If you do not make your dreams come true, it will not be because you lack opportunities, but because you do not know how to take advantage of the ones you have.
Never take into account the criticisms made against you, because they only try to demotivate you so that your dreams do not come true.
No one needs wings to fly, just imagination to dream.
The difference between dreaming and actually reaching your dreams lies in the work we do to see them fulfilled.
We waste time while we dream if we do nothing when we wake up to make our dreams come true.
When we dream awake, we live what we want. When we dream asleep, we live what we desire.
Sometimes we use silence to express our feelings.
We soon forget the caresses happiness gave us when adversity touches us.
When sadness appears, it does not let the sun of our smiles shine.
We all know what we want. What we do not know is where the manual that says how to make our dreams come true is.
Asleep we dream of what we desire, but awake we must work to make the dreams we have a reality.
We are always wrong when we think we will not be able to reach our dreams, and we are right when we dedicate ourselves to finding the path we will follow to reach them.
If we all get up when we fall, we should learn that lamenting will be of little use.
Living in solitude and feeling sorrow is like walking while looking only at the stones.
It is better to find ourselves enjoying our feelings than to lose ourselves by dwelling on our thoughts.
The problems we have can be enormous, big, or small, depending on the importance we give them.
Do not speak of what you do not know and do not explain what you do not understand.
It is useless for us to fall if we later prove that we learned nothing.
No one has learned to swim by staying on the shore looking at the sea.
Life is a school in which we sometimes pass and other times we fail, but in which we always learn.
He who chooses fools as teachers should not expect to learn good or great lessons.
Not knowing is not a problem. The real problem is not learning.
Life never gives bad lessons. What you might find sometimes are bad teachers.
Having dreams is not enough. You must be brave and wake up to go out and look for them.
Do not think that your dreams are far away. Keep dreaming so they do not slip through your fingers.
Whoever thinks that making their dream a reality is possible, feels that nothing is impossible.
We can stop dreaming when we make our dreams a reality, or simply when we give up.
The important thing is not the path, but what we learn while traveling the path.
We all feel pain when we fall, but some of us lament, and others get up.
It is preferable to live making mistakes than to spend life without moving out of fear of falling.
The brave prefer to die fighting while cowards choose to live in silence.
The important thing is not the pain we feel. The important thing is that we never give up.
People are wounds. They always heal, even though the scars on our souls are always noticeable.
We lost the day we gave up.
If when we fall we stay lamenting on the ground, the longer it will take us to reach the sky.
Neither free, nor imprisoned, nor dead. I will never stop fighting for what I feel.
Only whoever has fallen truly knows what they have suffered.
It is for cowards to abandon. It is for the brave to fight. And it is for heroes to fall and get back up to continue.
If we get tired, we can always rest, but if we give up, we will be able to achieve no success.
They will tell you many times that you cannot, so that you never try and do not think about the great worth you possess.
There are people who, because of the love they gave us, deserve to be remembered, and others who, because of the harm they did to us, it is fitting they be forgotten.
Even if you never managed to reach your dreams, no one can say you failed, because only he fails who never advances because he left his destiny in the hands of his fears.
Do not trust anyone who encourages you to jump, because there are those who are longing to applaud when they see you fail.
Once you have fallen, it will do you little good to lament for not having been more cautious.
The greatest problem we can have is not having a fear of dying, but having a fear of living.
If someone tries to sink you, prove to them that you know how to swim and that you will always stay afloat.
We suffer enough falls from our own mistakes for others to come and push us.
Do not think every time you fall that you failed. Think that you learned and got back up.
Never look at anyone without luck with contempt, because at any moment life can throw you to the ground and then you will know what it is to feel cold.
We will never again be who we were. We will never again live what we lived. So never let your fears decide for you.
Those who only know how to lament their wounds and scars will never be capable of being happy.
It is not that we sometimes lack strength. It is simply that we waste it paying attention to idiots.
We turn ourselves into our own worst enemies because we let our fears decide instead of letting our thoughts run free.
The coward goes into battle to win without fighting; the brave goes to fight without knowing if he will win.
Only he can dream who understood he had wings and wanted to learn to fly.
If you become the master of your dreams, you will never be a slave to your fears.
A bad life is led by whoever has a fear of living and ends up having a fear of dying.
Do not listen to whoever tells you that you cannot. Pay attention to whoever tells you that if you want to, you can.
It may hurt when we fall, but we learn a valuable lesson when we get up.
Whoever wants to extinguish your light with their lies only desires that the day arrives when you live in darkness.
The person who feels tears raining in their eyes and dries them, turning them into brilliant smiles, deserves all our admiration.
There will always be someone who tells us we will not manage to fulfill our dreams, but it is only to discourage us and so we do not chase them.
Whoever knows how to listen learns more than whoever does not let others speak.
From the earth we enjoy the shine of the stars, and if we were in the sky, we would verify how idiots shine on earth.
Your smile is a weapon that does not kill but that every fool detests.
The clothes you dress in do not make you beautiful. You look beautiful whenever you smile.
Whoever dresses in smiles writes all their days with joy.
Never dress in sadness; those colors do not suit you. Remember that you look more beautiful when you put on smiles.
The smile is what differentiates wisdom from ignorance.
When you see someone who gifts you smiles, remember that they learned to smile after swallowing many tears.
The smile is not only there for us to show it. It is also there for us to give it away.
A book is a sky in which words shine as if they were stars in your gaze.
If by day you read words, by night you will count stars in your dreams.
Words are the stars that guide travelers when they navigate the ocean of books.
There are gazes in which souls can be read and others that are sad empty pages.
Fear and sadness are the clouds that sometimes cloud our head.
Never let your thoughts be turned off. Let your feelings illuminate you.
Life is a box of colored pencils, and we paint our days according to what our emotions decide.
Life does not put the colors. You end up painting your life with the colors you choose.
The skin your tears run across will end up turning into wrinkles.
When you see clouds in your thoughts, count on it raining in your feelings.

The sea had daughters, who as children played in the waves, and when they grew up they turned into salt. The daughters of the sea traveled to our eyes, and they always try to escape because they want to return to their father to play.
Tears are the highways through which sorrows circulate.
We should never stop being children to enjoy playing, live dreaming, and write with smiles the days that life is gifting us.
There is no darkness in my dreams if asleep I see your smiles, nor is there a grey day when I have the light of your gazes.
What matters is not the shadow you cast because of how great you think you are, but the light you project because of the love with which you treat others.
Fear will never let you follow any path, and that is why if you pay attention to it, you will not reach any destination.
If you cry because you lose, you will lack the strength to get what you do not have.
In a world of lies, truths hurt as if they were wounds.
If every day we make hundreds of decisions, we have to assume that we may make some mistakes.
The brave look forward and the coward looks elsewhere.
Do not think you always have bad luck. It is likely you live with bad people.
Always take care of your words, because sometimes they turn into sharp knives and other times into the ammunition with which you cause wounds.
We may not always dare to live our dreams because, even if we do not admit it, we are afraid to live them.
If you let yourself be carried away by your fears, you will never know what it feels like when you manage to reach your dreams.
There are no eternal falls. There only exist people who forget that you stay on the ground when you do not get up.
Only he is brave who never gives up, because he does not let himself be defeated by the fear that paralyzes the coward.
Reaching your dreams does not depend on the strength you have, but on never giving up despite the exhaustion you feel.
Never think of the fall when you jump. Think that in the end you will fulfill your dreams when you fly.
To whoever expects to see you in a tight spot, prove to them that you learned how to swim because you know it is better to live swimming than to end up drowned.
If sadness knocks on your door, not opening to it is the best response.
Only whoever fell and got back up learned that life is a lesson for whoever never gave up.
Every day is an opportunity for us to demonstrate all the worth we possess.
We all have the right to have fears, but we all have the obligation to conquer them.
Fears are the excuses we make for ourselves because we think we will never be able to fulfill our dreams.
We are what we give, but we will never give what we do not have.
There is no weight you cannot lift, nor fall you cannot overcome.
Life contains all colors, and it is we who decide which ones are better or worse.
There will always be people who are like bad candies. They leave a bad taste in the mouth despite their pretty wrappers.
We live surrounded by people who cannot because they do not want to, and others who do not want to because they think they cannot.
If you want to always have good friends, choose those who are always sincere with you.
I have met so many fools that I only ask destiny not to introduce me to any more idiots.
There are no good or bad days. All days are the same until you run into the biggest fools.
We all dream of princes and princesses, and when we wake up we find ourselves with louts and commoners.
It is not necessary to wait for spring to arrive to see flowers, because you can find pricks in the streets every day.
Those who say that beauty is on the inside might be thinking of a wallet when it carries bills of different colors.
It is surprising that remedies against lice have been invented and there is still nothing to avoid the lousy people.
There is no worse sick person than a fool, because besides having no cure, over time they do not get better.
In ancient times we were illuminated by philosophy, and in modern times we live in darkness entertained watching some nonsense.
It is not necessary to be intelligent. Now it is enough to seem interesting to have people's attention.
We have the virtue of making plans and life has the flaw of making us live whatever the hell it pleases.
The lie of the salary allows the worker to believe that one day they will be a millionaire.
If you only kiss donkeys, you will spend your life listening to brays.
If no one told you today that you are incredible, it is because to idiots, a star is invisible.
What does it matter how others value us, if no one will ever care if they can help us.
You must always bother your enemy, for the simple fact of existing and being.
Those who compare people to cars have bad feelings, because people are not objects and they feel.
You will know you are with idiots when they tell you they see nothing out the windows and it is because they did not raise the blinds.
Children sometimes cry and it is not because they feel pain, but because they are demanding their parents give them their love.
So many human beings live in this world, and how few beings we find who listen, and who feel listened to.
With our actions we portray ourselves, and with our words we put on makeup.
